toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios

data.summary: Synthetic demo analysis for headset-stand under demo-direct at as-of 2026-10-24. Base target revenue margin 5% yields recommended price BRL 31.38 before discount. With no discount, contribution is BRL 1.5753 and revenue margin is 5.02%; with a 10% discount, charged price falls to BRL 28.24 and contribution becomes BRL -1.2507, so contribution is negative and the requested margin is not retained after discount.
assumptions: Confirmed synthetic demonstration product and rule were used; both are marked Demonstration and valid 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.
All listed charges are on the same revenue basis used by the deterministic calculator: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is based on the synthetic failure rate and full-print retry assumption embedded in the stored product costs.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the stored failure model and may differ from actual operations.
No marketplace verification is available; the rule is synthetic and not a current platform fee.
This is a draft recommendation only and requires human approval before any use.
